context: Kenji asks Hiroshi-elder advice about taking on a hard creative project.
purpose: Adult artist seeking guidance from elder figure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おとうさん、迷うてます。
lines.en: Dad, I'm wavering. I don't know if I should do this.
lines.style: Gentle, halting opening. Vulnerable admission, not seeking reassurance but needing to speak it aloud. Warm Kansai lilt. Voice softens on the second clause—almost apologetic for the doubt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Patient, steady. No pressure in the question—genuine curiosity. Warm Kansai cadence. Leans forward slightly with attention. The tone of a father who listens first.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: It's a big step. Takes more courage than I know if I have.
lines.style: Quiet, tentative. Vulnerability laid bare without dramatics. Kansai warmth underneath. Slight hesitation on 'courage'—checking whether he's allowed to admit fear. Breath comes easier at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: やらん後悔、ようないで。
lines.en: Not taking it—you'll carry that regret a long time.
lines.style: Measured, certain without being harsh. Kansai gentle. Not lecturing—simply stating what he knows to be true. Eyes steady. Wisdom without weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おとうさんの言う通りや。
lines.en: You're right. You've always been right about this.
lines.style: Small nod in the voice. Recognition settling in. Kansai warmth returning—more grounded now. Relief beneath the words. The certainty of a son who trusts his father's judgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: Then I'm with you on it. All the way.
lines.style: Tender, affirming. Kansai lilt carries warmth and solidarity. Slight lean-in quality—the implicit promise of support. Calm, steady delivery. This is his answer and his commitment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、決めます。
lines.en: Thank you, Dad. I'm going to do it.
lines.style: Resolved, grateful. Kansai softness now carries determination underneath. Voice lifts slightly—fear replaced by purpose. Respectful gratitude meeting quiet strength. Decision made.
